name: Fenrir
legendaryAbilityText: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card to treat all non-home systems at the edge of the game board as adjacent to each other until the end of your tactical action.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: They tried to fold spacetime more than 7 times.
flavourText: *Driven drom their overcrowded home worlds by a population crisis, desperate refugees fled too far too fast, plunging deep into the uncharted maw of the Fracture where escape became impossible.*
